About the job AI Engineer Research & Innovation - Surabaya (Project Based)

Meratus Group is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.

At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.

Position Overview : ﻿As an AI Engineer in our Research and Innovation division, you will explore the bleeding edge of technology. You will evaluate emerging trends, build Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and implement advanced AI systems that maximize operational efficiency and accelerate digital transformation.

Responsibilities

  • ﻿﻿R&D & Trend Analysis: Conduct deep-dive research into emerging technologies, industry developments, and competitor/vendor tech benchmarks.
  • PoC Development: Design, build, and execute rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and pilot programs to validate new AI solutions and engineering approaches.
  • System Optimization: Analyze current enterprise systems to identify bottlenecks and unlock opportunities for technology optimization.
  • Strategic Innovation Support: Contribute to strategic innovation programs, internal hackathons, digital transformation initiatives, and AI-driven business continuity roadmaps.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Maintain tech repositories and ensure proper knowledge transfer of innovation outcomes by creating comprehensive technical guidelines and research papers.

Requirements

  • ﻿﻿Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience developing machine learning models, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or generative AI applications.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or OpenAI APIs.
  • Proven background in designing and launching technical PoCs from scratch.
  • ﻿Excellent analytical and research-driven mindset with a passion for documentation and collaborative knowledge sharing.

Founded in 1957, Meratus pioneered Indonesia's dedicated Container liner service in 1990. Now as a leading maritime and logistics integrator in Southeast Asia, Meratus operates over 45 routes and maintains a network of 40 agent locations. With a fleet of 100 vessels, 3 container terminals, and 20 Container Logistic Centers and Warehouses, Meratus plays a crucial role in developing Indonesia's supply chain and logistics ecosystem.

Meratus prioritizes employee well-being through benefits like medical consultations, sports clubs, lactation rooms, and insurance. Regular engagement surveys help enhance employee satisfaction and foster a positive, collaborative culture. The company’s value, "We Put People First," reflects its commitment to nurturing talent and supporting professional growth. This approach underscores the importance of employee welfare and drives both domestic and international economic growth.

    • ⚓ Welcome to the fleet, ASD Harbor Tug Amman Nusantara 03!

      My first time onboard an operational Azimuth Stern Drive (ASD) Harbor Tug, witnessing the handover from Dumas Shipping Yard and sea trials covering maneuverability, firefighting mode, and water curtain operations — truly a whole new world of learning.

    • ⚓ 3.5 Months, 2 Operational Pillars, and New Lessons Learned 🚛

      25th September 2026 officially marked the completion of my first On the Job Training (OJT) in the Operations Division at       Meratus Group Surabaya Branch!

      Over the past 3.5 months, I had the opportunity to dive deep into two core areas of Marine and Land Operations. On the marine side, I gained hands-on exposure to berth planning, terminal operational patterns, vessel clearance, KPI tracking, and optimizing vessel discharge and loading productivity. Meanwhile, in land operations, I explored end-to-end container movements, depot operational dynamics, trucking management, Ex-Im workflows, T/S, and the operational nuances of both SOC and Leased containers.

      I am especially grateful for the opportunity to turn learning into action by delivering several impactful analytical tools. Throughout my training, I developed a Daily KPI Monitoring Dashboard, Stock & YOR forecast projections, CY stack discharge and productivity trackers, as well as problem and pattern analyses for WTB and depot operations.

      Finishing this OJT 1 alongside with my Commercial friends , , and as we got to learn together. The same goes with mas and even though we joined at different times.

      Thank you to Pak Pak Agus Margono, Pak , Pak , Pak Agus Saputra, Pak Tiara Jedianto, Pak , and the entire team for their patient guidance and continuous mentorship at Surabaya Branch.

      "Operations is where strategy meets execution, every metric tracked and every efficiency gained builds a stronger supply chain." ⛓️
